plugins.name: athanor
plugins.description: Self-sustaining agentic workflow orchestrator — cross-model adversarial planning with thin-leader dispatch. Vendored subset of CE 3.8.3 (33 ce-* skills after v0.11.2 scope-clarification cut) + superpowers 5.1.0 under athanor namespace (athanor identity commitments preserved). Standalone /athanor:lfg runs the pipeline through athanor-native commands. v0.11.7 extends the doc-drift scanner (v0.11.5) to Python docstrings + docs/STATE.md via ast.get_docstring per-file extractors, applies the v0.11.6 reclassification pattern to documented Residual entries, and ships a minimal B1 profile-mutation detection layer — 5th layer of the v0.11.3/4/5/6 companion-fix arc. Stop hook with multi-script confusables fold + paraphrase regex + conditional/attribution suppression, sentinel body normalized via .strip() (v0.11.6), and detection-only stderr warning on mid-session profile mutation (v0.11.7).
